notes.title: Some nice additions and changes!
notes.notes:
Patch notes :

Additions:
🔥 New system for switching the camera from third person to first person and vice versa.
🔥 New modifiable inputs in the parameters

Changes:
💠Some interfaces have been improved. 
💠Parameters are now arranged in the right order

We're still listening to you and will continue to read your feedback, so you're welcome if you want to help improve the game! Join us here: https://linktr.ee/anotherslimestudio !

Have fun!

notes.title: New MAJOR update!🙈
notes.notes:
Patch notes :

Additions:
🔥 Added a new Mini game during the treadmill event to keep busy if the other player calculates the combination to make
🔥 Added new skins to choose in the hub and as a reward during the mini game
🔥 Added new sound feedbacks when interacting with the environment
🔥 Added 8 new screen resolutions available in the option menu

Changes :
💠 Some sound feedbacks have been tweaked
💠 One of the lava level platforms has been slightly raised to avoid shortcuts
💠 Some changes have been applied to improve the game's FPS
💠 The game's gravity has been increased slightly to reduce players' time in the air
💠 The jump height has been improved to give players more momentum
💠 The orientation and size of the mobile platform buttons have been changed
💠 The in-game arrival information panel can be accepted directly
💠 When testing conveyor belts, checkout detectors have a higher delay

Fixes :
🛠️ Fixed some doors that did not open visually for the 2nd player
🛠️ Fixed the mobile platform that could get out of sync for the 2nd player
🛠️ Fixed the arena floor not rising for the 2nd player
🛠️ Fixed spike cube collisions that were too large
🛠️ Fixed graphics settings not working
🛠️ Fixed collisions on the first platform of the lava level
🛠️ Fixed one of the conveyor belts that was sucking up the cube and complicating the puzzle
🛠️ Fixed collisions in the story interface that could annoy players
🛠️ Fixed texture problems on the hub floor

We're listening to you and will continue to read your feedback, so you're welcome to help us improve the game! Join us here: https://linktr.ee/anotherslimestudio !

Have fun!

notes.title: New update! Major fixes and minor additions!🙈
notes.notes:
Patch notes :

Additions:
🔥 Added a new sound to indicate to players the validation of full gauges as well as burnt crates for the factory
🔥 Added a corridor between the two rooms at the bottom of the factory to allow players to join each other
🔥 Added a portal and corresponding buttons in this new corridor to access the next room
🔥 Added two doors to be opened to separate the corridor and the two player rooms
🔥 Added the name of the author of the new validation sound to the credits

Changes:
💠 Crate dropper collisions for the factory have been adjusted to simplify ‘shortcuts’ 
💠 The speed of the factory dropper has been increased to improve mobility
💠 Changed the font of the numbers linked to the goal puzzle buttons
💠 The access to the factory floor has been changed, the springboard has been destroyed cause it was no longer needed
💠 Some objects behind which the player could get stuck have been moved 
💠 The destinations of the teleporters leading to the factory for players 1 and 2 have been reversed
💠 The order in which some rooms were played was changed to alternate test and puzzle

Corrections :
🛠️ Fixed the options menu not closing from the pause menu
🛠️ Fixed the problem that prevented player 2 from throwing bananas quickly
🛠️ Fixed the detection of the crate dropper in the factory being reversed for player 2
🛠️ Fixed the visual problem in the portal room for player 2 after a reconnection

We're listening to you and will continue to read your feedback, so you're welcome to help us improve the game! Join us here: https://linktr.ee/anotherslimestudio !

Have fun!
